title: Castle Clash
tags: chess,strategy,2 player,robot,learn chess,puzzles,puzzle rush,daily puzzle,board game,online
description: Real chess on a clean, modern board. Play Oomba Bot at four levels, play a friend on one screen or online, learn every piece in short lessons, and train with more than 4,000 rated puzzles from the Lichess database: theme packs, a daily puzzle and Puzzle Rush. Watch your puzzle rating, streaks and skills grow on your own progress page.
notes: Complete chess rules (castling, en passant, promotion picker, check, checkmate, stalemate, threefold repetition, fifty-move rule, insufficient material) with SAN move list; the move generator matches the standard perft counts (window.__brbTest.perft). Own UI, no kit: a DOM board (64 cells, pieces as elements that slide with CSS transforms), the game's own Staunton-style SVG piece set, three board themes (Meadow, Walnut, Ocean), last-move and check highlights, legal-move dots, drag and drop and tap to move, a hint arrow, rank and file letters, player panels with captured pieces and the material lead, clocks in two-player games. Chrome in the Oomba tokens (Bricolage Grotesque from Google Fonts). Oomba Bot (a drawn robot face) plays at four levels; the robot searches in short time slices with setTimeout (no Web Worker under the frame CSP). Puzzles: the 24 hand-made Beginner path puzzles plus 4,160 puzzles from the Lichess puzzle database (CC0) in eight packs by rating band, public/vendor/data/castle-clash/<version>/p<band>.js, each loaded on demand with a script tag and its sha384 (scripts/chess-puzzles.mjs downloads, filters, replays every puzzle with this file's engine and writes the packs and the checksums between the PUZZLE PACKS markers). Modes: rated puzzles near the player's rating (Elo-like, start 800), 15 theme packs, a daily puzzle, Puzzle Rush (3 minutes, 3 mistakes), hints (piece, then arrow), retry, an animated solution. Sounds: wooden piece sounds (move, capture, castle, check, promotion, illegal, right, wrong, game end) synthesized with WebAudio into buffers, played only while BRB.sfx is not muted (window.__brbTest.sounds()). Saves settings, robot wins, lesson stars, Beginner path stars and puzzle progress (rating history, solved, streaks, rush best, per-theme results, seen puzzle ids) in localStorage key 'castle-clash-v1' (v 2; a version 1 save is migrated) and the game in progress in 'castle-clash-game-v1' (both through the SDK storage shim). Score (the player's own best, never ranked): BRB.score.submit(points, 'robot wins') with points = robot wins weighted Pawn 1, Knight 2, Bishop 4, Queen 8 (unchanged; the puzzle rating can go down, so it stays on the progress page). Online (BRB.match, a match frame from /play/castle-clash?match=<id>): the Play Online tile calls BRB.match.menu() (shown only when BRB.match exists); a match frame goes straight to the board and waits for the page's 'go' (names, every event so far), then both frames run the same rules and relay numbers only: mv {g, n, f, t, p} (game index, ply, 0x88 from/to, promotion 0-4) and act {g, a} (1 give up, 2 offer a draw, 3 yes, 4 no, 5 play again). Seat 0 plays White in even games. Online games are never saved locally, have no undo, hints or clock (window.__brbTest.online: state, inject, sent, act).
